returns.name: Form FR-900Q, Employer/Payor Withholding Tax - Quarterly Return
contents: Due by the last day of the month after the quarter: April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31; a quarterly filer files it even with no tax withheld, unless a final return was filed.
Monthly depositors enter the amount per month on the return; quarterly depositors the quarter's amount.
The employer remains responsible when a tax professional, bank or payroll service files and pays; the withholding account number OTR provided, not just the FEIN, must be used so payments are applied.
Filed electronically on MyTax.DC.gov; a bulk filing specification exists.

deposits.interpretation: OTR requires payments on a weekly, semi-weekly, monthly or quarterly basis, set up with OTR (the filing frequency 'is set up with OTR'), and a QUARTERLY return (Form FR-900Q) from everyone except annual filers (Form FR-900A). The instructions say 'Deposits are due by the 20th day of the following month, or on or before the 20th day of the month following the quarter being reported': MONTHLY depositors pay by the 20th of the following month and QUARTERLY depositors by the 20th of the month after the quarter (April 20, July 20, October 20, January 20). Payments made by a payroll service or other third party must also arrive by that date. A payment due on a non-business day (Saturday, Sunday, District legal holiday) is timely if made by the close of the next business day. WEEKLY and SEMI-WEEKLY schedules are named but no dates or thresholds are given, so they are NOT MODELLED: supplying them returns an error. The frequency is an INPUT (OTR assigns it); the look-back is not derived. Annual filers (FR-900A) are not modelled. THIS IS THE 2025 EDITION.

returns.name: Employer's Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report (Form UC-30)
contents: Due April 30, July 31, October 31 and January 31 (DOES).
The page does not state a weekend or holiday rule.

Reports and taxes not submitted on time are subject to penalty and interest: interest at 1.5 percent of the tax due per month or fraction thereof until paid, and a penalty of 10 percent of the tax due, but not less than $100 (DOES Reporting Questions page).
